the problem of high quality image capture in moderate light conditions.
the problem of capturing high-quality images of fast-moving objects.

the flutter shutter method can be extended for fast-moving objects by using a velocity-dependent shutter sequence.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a new shutter sequence design method that can be used to improve the image quality for fast moving objects.
the shutter sequence for flutter shutter should be dependent on object's velocity.

The main takeaway from our work is that
shutter speed is not a binary parameter, but rather a sequence that is velocity-dependent and can be used for motion deblurring of fast-moving objects.
shutter sequences should not be designed to capture the entire velocity range, and that the shutter sequence should be tailored to the velocity range of interest.
